zh.title: 印度FLY91訂購40架ATR72-600客機 創該廠商近十年最大訂單
zh.summary: 印度FLY91宣布訂購40架ATR 72-600客機；預計2027年至2032年間交付
body: 印度區域航空公司FLY91與飛機製造商ATR於2026年9月3日宣布達成一項價值約10億美元的合作協議，FLY91將訂購40架ATR 72-600型客機。相關交機時程排定於2027年至2032年間展開，旨在擴展該公司於印度境內的區域航線網絡。
這筆訂購案創下ATR近十年來最大的確認訂單紀錄，同時也是區域航空公司歷史上規模最大的單筆ATR訂單。此合約使得ATR在2026年的累計獲訂數量提升至54架，在該年度尚餘三個多月的情況下，已超越2025年全年的淨訂單總數。
成立營運未滿三年的FLY91，計畫在未來五年內將機隊規模從現有的6架擴充至60架。該公司創辦人兼行政總裁Manoj Chacko表示，ATR 72-600客機具備優異的營運經濟效益，能為印度各次級城市之間提供直接且高效的航空連結，成為公司下一階段擴充計畫的催化劑。
印度民航部長Kinjarapu Ram Mohan Naidu指出，區域連通性是印度航空業成長的核心支柱，連接中小城市與主要經濟中心為國家優先政策。配合政府推動的UDAN 2.0計畫，此類規模的區域運力投資將有助於將更多二級與三級城市納入國家經濟主流。
ATR行政總裁Nathalie Tarnaud Laude補充說明，ATR 72-600客機結合了經濟性、效率與可靠度，能協助航空公司提供價格合理的機票，並強化區域航空網絡。ATR市場調查資料顯示，印度每年約有46億人次的跨城市旅程，目前僅有約3%透過航空完成，顯示區域航空發展仍具備深厚的成長潛力。
FLY91主席兼主要投資方Convergent Finance管理合夥人Harsha Raghavan表示，區域連通性將成為印度下一階段經濟成長的關鍵驅動力。FLY91目前營運涵蓋多個邦的區域航線，專注於連接二級與三級城市。

en.title: FLY91 Places $1B Order for 40 ATR 72-600 Aircraft in Regional Fleet Expansion
en.summary: FLY91 places a firm order for 40 ATR 72-600 aircraft with deliveries scheduled from 2027 to 2032.
body: Indian regional carrier FLY91 and turboprop manufacturer ATR announced a firm order for 40 ATR 72-600 aircraft on September 3, 2026. The agreement is valued at approximately $1 billion, with aircraft deliveries scheduled to take place between 2027 and 2032 to support the airline's network expansion.

The agreement represents the largest firm order for ATR in nearly a decade, as well as the largest single order ever placed by a regional airline. The transaction brings ATR's total order intake for 2026 to 54 aircraft, surpassing its total net orders recorded throughout the full year of 2025.

FLY91 plans to expand its operational fleet from six aircraft to 60 over the next five years. Founder, Managing Director, and CEO Manoj Chacko stated that the ATR 72-600 offers the ideal operating economics for the carrier's network, serving as a catalyst for its next growth phase in linking emerging cities directly.

India's Union Minister for Civil Aviation Kinjarapu Ram Mohan Naidu highlighted that regional connectivity remains a fundamental pillar of the country's aviation strategy. He added that large-scale fleet commitments align with the government's UDAN 2.0 scheme to bring tier 2 and tier 3 cities into the economic mainstream.

ATR Chief Executive Officer Nathalie Tarnaud Laude noted that the turboprop model provides unmatched economics, efficiency, and reliability for short regional routes, enabling affordable fares across India. She emphasized that the fleet expansion aligns closely with the Indian government's ambitions under the regional connectivity framework.

Harsha Raghavan, Chairman of FLY91 and Managing Partner of lead investor Convergent Finance, stated that regional connectivity will be a critical enabler of India's broader economic growth. FLY91 currently operates regional routes connecting secondary and tertiary urban centers across multiple Indian states.

zh.title: 大韓航空與泰國航空工業簽署軍機維修合作協議
zh.summary: 大韓航空與泰國航空工業合作；維修泰國黑鷹直升機；推動技術培訓
body: 大韓航空於2026年9月2日在釜山科技中心與泰國國營的泰國航空工業（TAI）簽署協議，針對泰國軍用飛機的維修與檢修展開戰略合作。
根據協議，雙方首要合作項目為泰國陸軍UH-60黑鷹直升機的廠級維修，未來計劃擴大至泰國皇家武裝部隊營運的其他軍用機型。大韓航空亦將協助泰國航空工業標準化軍機維修流程，並為泰國人員提供技術培訓。
大韓航空航太部門自1991年起生產UH-60直升機，累積了豐富的維修支援經驗，迄今已完成超過5500架飛機的廠級維修與性能提升作業。

en.title: Korean Air Partners with Thai Aviation Industries for Military Aircraft MRO
en.summary: Korean Air signed a partnership with Thai Aviation Industries to maintain military aircraft including UH-60 helicopters.
body: Korean Air has signed a strategic partnership agreement with Thailand's state-owned Thai Aviation Industries on September 2, 2026, at the Tech Center in Busan. The agreement focuses on collaboration in maintenance, repair, and overhaul services for military aircraft operated in Thailand.

Under the initial scope of the agreement, both entities will cooperate on depot-level maintenance for the Royal Thai Army's UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters. The partnership is expected to expand to other military aircraft flown by the Royal Thai Armed Forces. Korean Air will also assist Thai Aviation Industries in standardizing maintenance processes and providing technical training.
Korean Air's aerospace division began producing UH-60 helicopters in 1991. The company has performed depot-level maintenance and performance upgrades for more than 5,500 aircraft.

zh.title: 法官駁回俄羅斯索回多倫多遭扣押安124貨機申請
zh.summary: 加拿大法官駁回俄羅斯索回多倫多遭扣押安124貨機的申請
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 報導，一名法官已駁回俄羅斯要求索回其在多倫多遭扣押的安托諾夫 An-124 貨機之申請。這架巨大的貨運飛機屬於俄羅斯籍的包機與空中貨運專門業者伏爾加-第聶伯航空（Volga-Dnepr Airlines）。
自2022年俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭至今，該架飛機已被困在多倫多皮爾遜國際機場（YYZ）長達四年半之久。在加拿大政府因該起入侵事件對俄羅斯籍飛機關閉領空之後，這架貨機在抵達加拿大時便隨即遭到滯留，無法離境。

en.title: Judge Rejects Russia's Bid to Reclaim Seized Antonov An-124 in Toronto
en.summary: A judge rejected Russia's bid to reclaim a Volga-Dnepr Airlines Antonov An-124 stranded in Toronto.
body: According to an aviation news report by Simple Flying, a judge has rejected Russia's legal bid to reclaim an Antonov An-124 cargo jet that was seized and remains stranded in Toronto. The massive cargo aircraft belongs to Volga-Dnepr Airlines, a Russian charter and airfreight specialist.

The cargo plane has been stuck at Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ) for the four and a half years that have elapsed since Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022. It was stranded immediately upon its arrival in Canada after the nation closed its airspace to Russian aircraft.
